notable_examples.snippet: treatment-ordinal coefficient was suggestive but not significant (beta = 0.77, p = 0.071)
notable_examples.why: Internal federation model result traceable to a named interpretation/task entity in-paragraph, not to any citation.

observations: Dominant false-positive driver: dataset/question entities attribute numbers via inline bare author-year citekeys (Cao2022, Dai2026, Bentham2025) that the lint cannot parse, and several files DO carry cite: source_refs in frontmatter (the sample's frontmatter_refs was uniformly empty and unreliable). A check that (a) parses inline author-year tokens and (b) reads real frontmatter source_refs would clear ~27/40. Second big class is structural noise: proper-name numbers (100,000 Genomes, 1000 Genomes), model versions (3.1, 3.5), entity/task IDs (0004, 0012, 493), and dates (01/02) should be excluded pre-flag. The residual genuine signal (~13) concentrates in report/plan prose: author-derived power heuristics, tooling counts (~150 warnings), and stipulated alpha/effect-size design values, several handwavy (~200, ~500).
